note: Medicine Bow-Routt NF campground on the southeast shore of Hog Park Reservoir, reached across the dam by gravel Forest roads from WY-70 (washboard in the curves). Sunny and open, with the reservoir in view over a band of shoreline trees; boat ramp nearby. Water, trash and toilet service in summer only; outside the summer season the campground stays open without fees or services while the road allows. --Claude

flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE lakefront -> lakeview: with rec.gov's per-site coordinates on Esri imagery and z19 tiles, the nearest sites (west loop 44-48, e.g. site 46 at 41.02668,-106.86424 and 47 at 41.02625,-106.86421) are 17-40 m from the reservoir edge, but a continuous band of conifers ~15-20 m deep lines the shore between every site and the water; sites 1/49/50 (south, by the dam) are ~50 m back behind the same band; back-loop site 43 (41.02761,-106.86355, FCFS) is ~45 m from the NW shore behind a shrub/conifer fringe. No site sits on an open apron to the water. The FS's 'open view of the reservoir' supports lakeview. The stored evidence ('open grass apron ~20-30m ... thin shore fringe only') does not hold at z19, and a thin line of trees is a view anyway.
